behaviors.description: Run an app that consumes piped stdin and changes and restores terminal settings.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation of the fixture app and a foreground pipeline in an interactive pseudo-terminal shell.
behaviors.expected: The app receives the exact marker through a pipe, applies and restores terminal settings, and exits zero without job-control suspension.

mappings.rationale: The installed fixture exercises terminal-setting operations that can suspend a process even when ordinary terminal writes succeed.
